mapper.insert: insert into message (userId, title, content, isRead, createTime) values (#{userid,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isread,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createtime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select messageId, userId, (select userName from user where message.userId = user.userId) userName, title, content, isRead, createTime from message where messageId = #{messageid,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select messageId, userId, (select userName from user where message.userId = user.userId) userName, title, content, isRead, createTime from message where userId = #{userid} order by createTime desc limit #{begin}, #{size}
select count(*) from message where userId = #{userid}
select count(*) from message where userId = #{userid} and isRead = 0
